# player/gordon_joystick.asm: Joystick control of Gordon

Range `$917A-$91F4`. Source: [player/gordon_joystick.asm](../../../../src/player/gordon_joystick.asm). Index: [the reference](../../index.md).

## Names

<a id="gordon_read_stick"></a>
### [`gordon_read_stick`](../../../../src/player/gordon_joystick.asm#L6) `$917A`

*label*

Reads the joystick of the player into $1b. When the stick holds the direction $30, the speed $32 goes up and Gordon moves on.

- **Jumped to from:** [`gordon_move`](gordon_move.md#gordon_move) [`$913C`](../../../../src/player/gordon_move.asm#L96), [`gordon_move`](gordon_move.md#gordon_move) [`$914B`](../../../../src/player/gordon_move.asm#L105)

Starts 4 steps ($37) to the square $07/$08.

<a id="gordon_new_direction"></a>
### [`gordon_new_direction`](../../../../src/player/gordon_joystick.asm#L38) `$91A0`

*label*

Takes a new direction from the stick: bit 0 up, bit 1 down, bit 2 left, bit 3 right. No direction stops Gordon.

- **Jumped to from:** [`$9181`](../../../../src/player/gordon_joystick.asm#L20)

<a id="gordon_turn"></a>
### [`gordon_turn`](../../../../src/player/gordon_joystick.asm#L68) `$91D3`

*label*

When the new direction is the blocked direction $31, Gordon stays. Else the speed $32 goes to 0 and Gordon turns on the square $33/$34.
